en.bodyHtml:
In this guide you carry out Troubleshooting in CyberPanel via CyberPanel. Change only what belongs to troubleshooting, CyberPanel, then verify the result.

Specific to “Troubleshooting in CyberPanel” — search/context terms: troubleshooting in cyberpanel. This belongs with CyberPanel and is not a generic hosting blurb.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Topic: troubleshooting, CyberPanel
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Start in CyberPanel and only make the change described by “Troubleshooting in CyberPanel”.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on troubleshooting.
  4. Apply the CyberPanel update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Check whether troubleshooting, CyberPanel works elsewhere (other network, webmail vs client, staging vs live).
  7. Correlate with the last change; roll back or fix one cause at a time.
  8. Finish “Troubleshooting in CyberPanel”: confirm troubleshooting, CyberPanel shows the intended result and briefly note what you changed.

Verify

  • Result for troubleshooting, CyberPanel matches “Troubleshooting in CyberPanel”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside troubleshooting CyberPanel
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result
  • “Troubleshooting in CyberPanel” is complete only if troubleshooting, CyberPanel behaves as expected outside the panel.

Tip: Work in small steps: get troubleshooting, CyberPanel right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if troubleshooting, CyberPanel touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
